name: undefined Block
purpose: Expose a lean upload and review workflow while AI remains proposal-only and backend submission stays deterministic.
invariants: Blocks expose lean controls and standardized outputs.
Blocks import Dysium System* exports and never provider internals.
Hidden admin and all-forms access must not clutter normal workflow blocks.

contract.job: Expose a lean upload and review workflow while AI remains proposal-only and backend submission stays deterministic.
contract.incomingHandoff: Operator has an unstructured document and needs a safe draft.
contract.outgoingHandoff: Approved data is submitted through backend validation or returned for correction.

validationBehavior.blockedState: AI proposals remain drafts until a reviewer approves and backend validation passes.

roleVisibility.rule: Workflow users see only task controls and standardized outputs; System Manager keeps full DocType access in hidden all-forms admin.
